methodological_commitments: Reproduce analysis of MinSum.budget-10.adaptive neoantigen vaccine optimization from simulation data

Quantitative metrics: per-cell immune response probability (p_response), tumor cell coverage ratio (fraction of cells with p_response above threshold, e.g., 0.5), IoU of optimal vaccine compositions across replicates/simulations
Data processing: aggregate vaccine-element scores across 10 replicates for 100-cells.10x simulations
Validation: distributions from final-response-likelihoods.csv and sim-specific-response-likelihoods.csv
named_methods: MinSum objective (minimize sum of -log p_response or similar)
protocols: Use vaccine-elements.scores.*.csv for cell-level response probabilities per mutation/vaccine_element
cell-populations.csv for presented peptides/mutations per cell
